The staff Peto remembered us as a family, we exchanged greetings and had a very good morning.

We also had a wide variety of coffees here for breakfast, and we were very grateful that they didn't say anything and brought it.

Memorizing and speaking to customers is not easy.
I found Peto's hospitality once again great.
